svg.title: Asteria CanSat system block diagram
svg.text: UK CanSat 2026–27 · atmospheric optics descent probe
PTFE diffuser over the light sensors
3.3 V to every sensor through the chain
Recovery: parachute (ripstop nylon, spill hole) → snap swivel → eye bolt in the top cap
mechanical only · connection tested to 50 N · 10–15 m/s descent
I²C addresses are board defaults – check against each datasheet. Diagram drawn with Claude Code (Anthropic), Nov 2026 – reference as AI-assisted.
